scope: Reviewed Wikimedia Commons photographs that can be linked to an exact current-model, exact model-year palette label without treating a photograph as factory-paint proof.

policy.identity_requirement: The Commons metadata must identify the exact Chevrolet model and model year represented by the archive row.
policy.label_requirement: The Commons description must print the same complete color label as a reviewed model-year palette source.
policy.visual_requirement: The retained archive image must be visually reviewed as a clear complete-vehicle color reference.
policy.factory_paint_boundary: A Commons caption and photograph do not prove original factory finish. Every link remains factory-paint unverified unless a separate authoritative vehicle-specific source is retained.

links.commons_metadata_evidence: 2024 Chevrolet Trax ACTIV photographed in New Castle, Pennsylvania. Finished in Crimson Metallic.
links.attribution: MercurySable99 - 2024 Chevrolet Trax ACTIV, front left, 07-12-2023 - CC BY-SA 4.0
links.note: The Commons description prints the exact reviewed 2024 palette label and the retained photograph was visually reviewed. This is a user-facing color example only; original factory finish and paint code remain unverified.
